title: UserRoleRecord
description: A federated user's role state after a grant/revoke. 'role' is what is STORED in the users table; 'env_admin' is whether the ADMIN_SUBJECTS environment allowlist also names this subject, in which case the caller is admin regardless of 'role' — the allowlist is evaluated first on the auth path and short-circuits, which is what makes it a break-glass path no database write can revoke.

subject.description: The federated 'issuer:subject' string this row is keyed on.

role.description: The stored role: 'admin', 'user', or '' for a row whose role has never been set. '' is the table's 'not set' sentinel, not a role; it resolves to 'user' at the auth path.

role_set_by.description: Subject of the admin who LAST changed this role; empty if never set. Append-only audit (ADR-0004 decision 6): a later change overwrites it, a revoke never blanks it.

role_set_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of that last change; empty if never set.

env_admin.description: True when ADMIN_SUBJECTS names this subject. The caller is then admin on the auth path no matter what 'role' says, and revoking the stored role does NOT take the admin away — that is an environment edit plus a restart.
